name: tickets-ti
description: Sistema de Gestión de Tickets de Soporte TI — Ingeniería de Software II

scripts.dev: concurrently -n authcore,domain,frontend "npm run dev --prefix authcore" "npm run dev --prefix domain-service" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix authcore && npm install --prefix domain-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate --prefix authcore && npm run migrate --prefix domain-service
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix authcore && npm test --prefix domain-service
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
